description_en: Queries the list of bindings between service instances and real numbers, including the binding time, number creation time, and the number of real numbers bound to a specific service instance
description_zh: 查询服务实例与真实号码绑定后的数据列表，包括绑定真实号的时间，号码创建时间，某个服务实例下绑定真实号的数量等
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi query-virtual-number-relation --prod-code dyvms --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --route-type 0 --qualification-id 10000005420000 --region-name-city '浙江/杭州' --spec-id 1 --related-num 02131440000 --phone-num 057100000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryVirtualNumberRelation

parameters.help_en: The product name. Default value: dyvms
parameters.name: prod_code

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The routing type. Valid values:

0: location-first.

1: random
parameters.help_zh:
路由类型。取值：

0：归属地优先。

1：随机
parameters.name: route_type

parameters.help_en: The qualification ID. This parameter is optional
parameters.name: qualification_id

parameters.help_en:
The location to which the real number belongs.

You can query the number location on the Real Number Management page in the Voice Messaging console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal)
parameters.help_zh:
真实号码归属地。

您可以在语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal)真实号管理页面，查询号码归属地
parameters.name: region_name_city

parameters.help_en:
The number type. Valid values:

1: virtual operator number.
2: carrier number.
3: number starting with 95
parameters.help_zh:
号码类型。取值：

1：虚商号码。
2：运营商号码。
3：95开头的号码
parameters.name: spec_id

parameters.help_en:
The real number.

You can obtain the real number on the Real Number Management page in the Voice Messaging console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal)
parameters.help_zh:
真实号码。

您可以在语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal)真实号管理页面，获取真实号
parameters.name: related_num

parameters.help_en:
The virtual number.

You can obtain the service instance ID on the Service Instance Management page in the Voice Messaging console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/virtual/list)
parameters.help_zh:
虚拟号码。

您可以在语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/virtual/list)服务实例管理页面，获取服务实例ID
parameters.name: phone_num

Code.description_en:
The request status code.

A value of 200 indicates the request was successful.
For other error codes, refer to [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。

返回200代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）

Data.description_en:
The list of bindings between service instances and real numbers. The following fields are included:

relatedNum: the real number.
virtualNum: the service instance ID.
createTime: the time when the number was activated.
specName: the provider name.
pageNo: the current page number.
pagSize: the number of entries per page.
total: the total number of entries.
regionNameProvince: the province to which the number belongs.
regionNameCity: the city to which the number belongs.
corpName: the enterprise name
Data.description_zh:
服务实例和真实号绑定后的关系列表。部分字段含义：

relatedNum：真实号码。
virtualNum：服务实例ID。
createTime：号码开通时间。
specName：供应商名称。
pageNo：当前页码。
pagSize：每页显示的条数。
total：总数。
regionNameProvince：号码归属省。
regionNameCity：号码归属城市。
corpName：企业名称
